title: Floor plan templates
intro: Save the floor plan as it is (halls, background images, where the switches are, seat blocks) and start from it later, or share it with another LAN as a file. Templates never hold check-ins, nicks, IPs, MACs, secrets or accounts.
empty: No templates yet. Save the floor plan as one to start from it next time.
deleteQuestion: Delete the template "{{name}}" with all its versions? The floor plan stays as it is.
saveAgainHelp: The floor plan as it is now becomes the newest version. The last 10 versions are kept.
name: Name
noEventData: Only the layout goes in: no check-ins, nicks, IPs, MACs, serials, secrets or accounts.
replacesAll: This replaces the whole floor plan: halls, background images and seat blocks. Switches the template doesn't have are taken off the plan, not deleted. It goes to the audit log.
replacesHall: This replaces what is in {{hall}}: its background image, seat blocks and switches. Other halls stay as they are. It goes to the audit log.
applied: Done: {{halls}} hall(s), {{seat_blocks}} seat block(s), {{switches_placed}} switch(es) placed, {{switches_added}} added by hand.
importHelp: A template file downloaded from Floorbit. Anything that isn't layout (event data) is taken out.
notJson: This file is not a template (not JSON).
importedDropped: Imported "{{name}}". Taken out because templates don't hold them: {{fields}}.
